images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: The Brannock went into the Seam at slack water, which was when every engineer in the Calyx said it should, and for eleven seconds Illuminara thought they might be right.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Brannock je vstopil v Seam ob mirni vodi, ko bi po besedah vseh inženirjev v Calyxu moral, in enajst sekund je Illuminara mislila, da imajo morda prav.
